query: SELECT DISTINCT i.conversation_id AS "conversation_id!" FROM idempotency i JOIN conversations c ON c.id=i.conversation_id WHERE i.execution_status='queued' AND c.state='active' AND c.profile->>'decision_engine' IS NOT NULL AND NOT (c.profile->>'decision_engine' = ANY($1)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sandbox_instances s WHERE s.conversation_id=i.conversation_id) LIMIT $2
